_doc: Twain's idle frame's barrier (Phase 8 M10; Project Redmond's own design, D-183): the server stands one round each idle frame (her second frame from the round's start, and the one she leaves when she swaps) and takes it away as she wakes that frame or it dies. A straight armoured wall in front of the crouched frame: a front slab 0.84 m wide to 1.02 m, a band of bulletproof glass across it at the frame's eyes (1.02-1.2 m), armour over that to 1.34 m, and a short cheek plate at each end turned 30 degrees back; open at the sides, above and behind. Every part stops bullets, bodies and throws; a blast or the maul breaks the whole barrier. Its camera's lens is just out past the glass at the frame's eyes.
name: Frame barrier
